Nvidia reports 9.3% passive stake in Nebius Group NV as of July 13, SEC filing

NVIDIA is disclosing that it effectively controls about 22.26 million Class A shares of Nebius Group N.V., most of them via a large pre‑funded warrant it can’t use or sell until September 11, 2026.

What The 22,256,412 Shares Include

•	1,190,476 Class A ordinary shares that NVIDIA already holds (previously reported on its March 31, 2026 Form 13F).

•	21,065,936 Class A ordinary shares that would be issued if NVIDIA exercises a pre‑funded Class A share purchase warrant it acquired on March 11, 2026.

Exercise And Sale Restrictions

•	NVIDIA is currently prohibited from exercising the warrant before September 11, 2026.

•	NVIDIA is also prohibited from selling the shares underlying the warrant before September 11, 2026.
